statements.statement: school committee requested an article for the November 2026 special town meeting to appropriate additional state aid to the school department's FY27 operating budget

school committee voted 4-0 on June 24 to request the select board schedule a special town meeting to appropriate additional state aid, after the Senate budget showed a big increase in the smart growth aid line
superintendent's July 8 spending plan (two reading specialists, restoring the high school principal to full-time, 72 Ignite license seats) totaled $477,896
total unappropriated state aid (education and general government combined) was $471,121, less than the $477,896 spending plan
the general government share of the unappropriated state aid was $73,998, including an increase in UGGA and in exemptions for veterans, blind persons, surviving spouses and the elderly
savings from the FY27 health insurance plan changes were expected to possibly cover one reading specialist for FY27, pending confirmation with the school business manager
superintendent proposed requesting $350,000 of the additional state aid to address the district's most immediate critical needs
school committee unanimously approved (4-0) the revised spending plan for the additional state aid on July 15
school committee voted 3-1 to approve a special town meeting article appropriating $350,000 of the additional state aid
residents were told during the override discussion that if the override failed, or if additional state aid became available, the board would revisit school funding
a member said the recommendation had originally been to restore approximately $418,000 in new education funding
a member said the recommendation shifted down from about $418,000 to just $350,000 for schools
the additional $471,000 in state aid comes from a state budget that grew about 4% to a total of $63.4 billion
the chair said the net education aid amount, after assessments, will be less than $418,000 and closer to $400,000 give or take $5,000, to be discussed at the finance committee hearing
